note: What a server sends to place a camp on the map and say how it is drawn. Its identifier is wider than a byte, so it travels behind the escape. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: x
fields.note: Where the camp sits, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: y
fields.note: Where it sits, in height, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: Names the mark a client draws, by a name from the game's own data.

fields.name: revealEvent
fields.note: What makes the unit known to a side that cannot see it.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Which side the camp belongs to, where it belongs to one.

fields.name: timerKind
fields.note: Which clock the client shows for it.

fields.name: expires
fields.note: When the camp is next due, in seconds.
